name: cursor-cycle-monitor
description: Live Cursor billing cycle spend, remaining balance, daily burn, and renewal countdown in your status bar.

cursorCycleMonitor.defaultLimitDollars.description: Fallback monthly dollar allowance when no individual admin spend limit is set.

cursorCycleMonitor.timezoneOffsetHours.description: Timezone offset in hours from UTC used to calculate Today's spend (e.g., 5.5 for IST, 0 for UTC, -5 for EST).

cursorCycleMonitor.refreshIntervalSecond.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh usage from Cursor's API.
